items.name: Roy
items.summary: An AI royalty-statement analyst for musicians and publishers that I designed, built and run end to end.
items.problem: Royalty statements come in dozens of inconsistent formats.
built: The whole product, solo: product and design, Next.js frontend and API routes, Supabase Postgres database and migrations, Clerk auth, Gemini-powered analysis and chat, Vercel deployment, and day-to-day live operations.
A statement parser that uploads, normalizes and analyzes royalty statements across 37 formats.
CI with Vitest unit tests and Playwright end-to-end tests gating every pull request.
results: 100% parsing accuracy across 37 statement formats, verified in CI on every change.
Built with AI-agent-driven development behind PR checks.

items.name: Sensational Concrete
items.summary: The website for a local concrete contractor, which I designed, built and run end to end.
built: The whole site: design, Next.js frontend, a quote-request API that emails leads to the owner via Resend, Vercel deployment and analytics, and ongoing operations.
Structured data and generative-engine optimization so AI assistants like ChatGPT can understand and cite the business. The owner reports leads from ChatGPT users.
Lead-source tracking on the quote form ("How did you hear about us?" plus UTM capture).
CI with lint, type checks, build, quote-form tests and an SEO check.

items.name: Viru Andean House
items.summary: A pre-launch brand site and storefront for curated Andean textiles, jewelry and pantry goods, a partnership between Jose Castillo and Crystal Wallstrom.
built: A Next.js (App Router) site on Vercel that renders a pre-launch experience with a sign-up list while commerce stays off.
Headless Shopify commerce, Resend email and a Sanity CMS, each switched on by its own environment variables.
CI with lint, type checks, build and Playwright smoke tests on every pull request.

agents.text: I run a small team of AI agents across engineering, finance and marketing. Every change goes through pull requests, automated tests and CI guardrails, and I verify the results myself before anything ships.

items.role: Sr. Royalty Data Analyst · June 2015 – August 2019
items.text: Managed royalty operations & analytics of Warner/Chappell Music's sub-publisher and composer accounts across North America.

items.role: Sr. Royalty Reporting Analyst · August 2019 – November 2021
items.text: Oversaw the annual processing of 7.5k royalty statements with $50M scope on behalf of DC Entertainment, Water Tower Records and Warner Bros. Entertainment.

items.role: Associate Director, Royalty & Data Operations · November 2021 – March 2023
items.text: Owned end-to-end payout operations and data infrastructure for on-platform and off-platform royalties through SoundCloud for Artists.

items.role: Data Analyst II, Global Partnerships & Content · March 2023 – September 2024; Data Analyst II, Business & Monetization - Generative AI · November 2024 – May 2025
items.text: Designed, built, and maintained scalable, privacy-conscious data infrastructure powering Meta's Generative AI Agent platform.

Lead the modernization of event-driven data pipelines and streaming analytics for Spark's portfolio of dating apps (Christian Mingle, JDate, etc.), increasing scalability, reliability and speed of data delivery.
